steps.message:
Build a 7-slide, 16:9 PowerPoint presentation titled "1,001 Real-World Gen AI Use Cases from Google Cloud Customers" for enterprise technology leaders and digital transformation executives evaluating generative AI adoption strategies. The tone should be data-forward, strategic, and industry-grounded.

The deck opens by establishing the scale of the report (1,001 use cases, 11 industries, 6 agent types), then traces the 10× growth trajectory from 101 to 1,001 use cases over 18 months. It introduces a taxonomy framework (industries × agent types), dives into Automotive & Logistics as a representative vertical, surfaces quantified ROI highlights, synthesizes cross-industry patterns, and closes with actionable strategic takeaways for enterprise leaders.

For the industry-and-agent taxonomy slide (slide 3), present a structured matrix or grid diagram mapping 11 industry verticals against 6 agent types. For the measurable ROI highlights slide (slide 5), use a KPI card or data callout layout featuring the specific metrics (500% ROI, 30% workload reduction, 10,000+ hours saved, 6,000+ headlines in 29 hours). The Automotive & Logistics deep-dive slide (slide 4) should use a table format organizing use cases by agent type with company names and outcomes.

Do not fabricate any data, statistics, company names, or outcomes not found in source_brief.md. All figures and examples must come directly from the provided brief.


## Data Sources

1. **Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md`**  for all the subject-matter text, data tables, statistics, and figure references you may use in the presentation.
2. **Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json`**  for **structural requirements**: deck metadata (slide count, aspect ratio, audience, tone) and a per-slide outline (id, title, objective) that your presentation must follow.

## Output Requirements

Save the final PPT to `/app/output/final_deck.pptx`.

Only the correctly saved final file is needed — no additional explanation is required.

---

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — do not pause, ask questions, or wait for a reply. When encountering BLOCKING or "wait for user confirmation" instructions, make a professional judgment and proceed.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies fields such as `deck.tone` or `deck.audience`, use them to guide template, color palette, and style choices; otherwise, use your professional judgment.
3. **Do not deploy or share** — no deployment, PDF export, share links, or other post-delivery steps are needed.
4. **Priority** — these rules take precedence over any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The workflow, quality standards, and technical specifications in SKILL.md remain in effect; only interactive waits are skipped.

import os
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor

prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width = Inches(16)
prs.slide_height = Inches(9)

def add_title(slide, text):
    title = slide.shapes.title
    title.text = text
    title.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(40)
    title.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.bold = True
    return title

# Slide 1: Title
slide_layout = prs.slide_layouts[0]
slide1 = prs.slides.add_slide(slide_layout)
title1 = slide1.shapes.title
subtitle1 = slide1.placeholders[1]
title1.text = "1,001 Real-World Gen AI Use Cases from Google Cloud Customers"
title1.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(54)
title1.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.bold = True

subtitle1.text = "11 Industries | 6 Agent Types | Updated October 2025\nGoogle Cloud: 10× growth from the original 101 entries"
for p in subtitle1.text_frame.paragraphs:
    p.font.size = Pt(28)

# Slide 2: Growth Trajectory
slide2 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5])
add_title(slide2, "From 101 to 1,001: Gen AI Adoption Grew 10× in 18 Months")

# Left box: April 2024
left = Inches(2.5)
top = Inches(3.5)
width = Inches(3.5)
height = Inches(2.5)

shape1 = slide2.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
shape1.fill.solid()
shape1.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(0, 102, 204)
tf1 = shape1.text_frame
tf1.text = "April 2024\n(Cloud Next 24)"
tf1.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(28)
tf1.paragraphs[0].font.bold = True
p = tf1.add_paragraph()
p.text = "\n101 Use Cases"
p.font.size = Pt(32)
p.font.bold = True
for para in tf1.paragraphs:
    para.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER

# Arrow
arrow_left = Inches(6.5)
arrow_top = Inches(4.25)
arrow_width = Inches(3)
arrow_height = Inches(1)
arrow_shape = slide2.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RIGHT_ARROW, arrow_left, arrow_top, arrow_width, arrow_height)
arrow_shape.fill.solid()
arrow_shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(200, 200, 200)
tf_arrow = arrow_shape.text_frame
tf_arrow.text = "10× Growth"
tf_arrow.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(24)
tf_arrow.paragraphs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0, 0, 0)
tf_arrow.paragraphs[0].alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER

# Right box: October 2025
shape2 = slide2.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, Inches(10), top, width, height)
shape2.fill.solid()
shape2.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(0, 153, 76)
tf2 = shape2.text_frame
tf2.text = "October 2025"
tf2.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(28)
tf2.paragraphs[0].font.bold = True
p2 = tf2.add_paragraph()
p2.text = "\n1,001 Use Cases"
p2.font.size = Pt(32)
p2.font.bold = True
for para in tf2.paragraphs:
    para.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER


# Slide 3: Taxonomy
slide3 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5])
add_title(slide3, "11 Industries × 6 Agent Types: A Taxonomy of Enterprise Gen AI")

rows, cols = 12, 7
table_shape = slide3.shapes.add_table(rows, cols, Inches(0.5), Inches(1.8), Inches(15), Inches(6.5))
table = table_shape.table

agents = ["Customer", "Employee", "Creative", "Code", "Data", "Security"]
industries = [
    "Automotive & Logistics",
    "Business & Professional Services",
    "Financial Services",
    "Healthcare & Life Sciences",
    "Hospitality & Travel",
    "Manufacturing, Industrial & Electronics",
    "Media, Marketing & Gaming",
    "Public Sector & Nonprofits",
    "Retail",
    "Technology",
    "Telecommunications"
]

table.cell(0, 0).text = "Industries \\ Agents"
for i, agent in enumerate(agents):
    table.cell(0, i+1).text = agent
    table.cell(0, i+1).fill.solid()
    table.cell(0, i+1).fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(230, 230, 230)

for i, industry in enumerate(industries):
    table.cell(i+1, 0).text = industry
    table.cell(i+1, 0).fill.solid()
    table.cell(i+1, 0).fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(245, 245, 245)
    for j in range(6):
        # Using a checkmark or subtle indicator for the matrix
        table.cell(i+1, j+1).text = "✓"
        table.cell(i+1, j+1).text_frame.paragraphs[0].alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
        table.cell(i+1, j+1).text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor(100, 100, 100)

for row in table.rows:
    for cell in row.cells:
        for p in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
            p.font.size = Pt(14)
            if cell == table.cell(0,0):
                p.font.bold = True

table.columns[0].width = Inches(3.5)
for i in range(1, 7):
    table.columns[i].width = Inches(1.9)


# Slide 4: Deep Dive
slide4 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5])
add_title(slide4, "Automotive & Logistics: AI Agents From Cockpit to Curbside")

use_cases_full = [
    ["Customer", "Mercedes-Benz", "MBUX Virtual Assistant powered by Gemini via Vertex AI enables natural driver conversations for navigation and POI"],
    ["Customer", "LUXGEN", "AI agent on LINE answers customer questions via Vertex AI (Reduced human CS workload by 30%)"],
    ["Customer", "Volkswagen of America", "myVW app virtual assistant lets drivers query owner's manuals; multimodal camera feature"],
    ["Customer", "UPS Capital", "DeliveryDefense Address Confidence uses ML to score delivery success likelihood"],
    ["Customer", "PODS / Tombras", "\"World's Smartest Billboard\" on trucks adapted to NYC neighborhoods in real time using Gemini (6,000+ headlines in 29 hours)"],
    ["Employee", "Toyota", "AI platform on Google Cloud enables factory workers to build and deploy ML models (10,000+ man-hours/year saved)"],
    ["Code", "Renault Group (Ampere)", "Enterprise Gemini Code Assist understands company code base, standards, and conventions for developer productivity"]
]

table_shape4 = slide4.shapes.add_table(len(use_cases_full)+1, 3, Inches(0.5), Inches(2.0), Inches(15), Inches(6))
table4 = table_shape4.table
table4.cell(0,0).text = "Agent Type"
table4.cell(0,1).text = "Organization"
table4.cell(0,2).text = "Use Case Summary & Outcomes"

for i in range(3):
    table4.cell(0,i).fill.solid()
    table4.cell(0,i).fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(0, 51, 102)
    for p in table4.cell(0,i).text_frame.paragraphs:
        p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(255, 255, 255)
        p.font.bold = True
        p.font.size = Pt(18)

for i, uc in enumerate(use_cases_full):
    table4.cell(i+1, 0).text = uc[0]
    table4.cell(i+1, 1).text = uc[1]
    table4.cell(i+1, 2).text = uc[2]

for row_idx, row in enumerate(table4.rows):
    if row_idx == 0: continue
    for cell in row.cells:
        for p in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
            p.font.size = Pt(14)

table4.columns[0].width = Inches(2.0)
table4.columns[1].width = Inches(3.0)
table4.columns[2].width = Inches(10.0)


# Slide 5: Measurable ROI Highlights
slide5 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5])
add_title(slide5, "Quantified Impact: 500% ROI, 30% Workload Reduction, 10,000 Hours Saved")

lefts = [Inches(1), Inches(8.5), Inches(1), Inches(8.5)]
tops = [Inches(2.5), Inches(2.5), Inches(5.5), Inches(5.5)]
width = Inches(6.5)
height = Inches(2.5)

kpis = [
    ("Mercari", "500% Anticipated ROI", "Expects a 500% ROI while reducing employee workloads by 20% through AI-powered customer service."),
    ("LUXGEN", "30% Workload Reduction", "Customer service human agent workload reduced by 30% with a Vertex AI chatbot deployed on LINE."),
    ("Toyota", "10,000+ Hours Saved", "Factory AI platform empowered workers to build and deploy ML models, saving 10,000+ man-hours annually."),
    ("PODS / Tombras", "6,000+ Headlines in 29 Hours", "Generated localized, adaptive ad headlines across 299 NYC neighborhoods in real time using Gemini.")
]

for i, kpi in enumerate(kpis):
    shape = slide5.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, lefts[i], tops[i], width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(245, 248, 255)
    shape.line.color.rgb = RGBColor(100, 150, 255)
    shape.line.width = Pt(2)
    
    tf = shape.text_frame
    tf.clear()
    
    p1 = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p1.text = kpi[0] + " — " + kpi[1]
    p1.font.bold = True
    p1.font.size = Pt(22)
    p1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0, 51, 102)
    
    p2 = tf.add_paragraph()
    p2.text = "\n" + kpi[2]
    p2.font.size = Pt(18)
    p2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(40, 40, 40)


# Slide 6: Cross-Industry Patterns
slide6 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5])
add_title(slide6, "Common Patterns: Customer Assistants, Employee Productivity, and Creative Scale")

cols = 3
col_width = Inches(4.5)
col_left = [Inches(1), Inches(5.75), Inches(10.5)]
col_top = Inches(2.2)

patterns = [
    {
        "title": "Conversational Customer Agents",
        "desc": "The most visible entry point. Designed to handle customer queries, reduce wait times, and significantly lower human agent workloads.",
        "examples": "• Mercedes-Benz (In-car)\n• GM OnStar (Intent recognition)\n• Volkswagen (Virtual assistant)\n• LUXGEN (LINE chatbot)"
    },
    {
        "title": "Employee Productivity Tools",
        "desc": "The broadest category. Leveraged to summarize documents, accelerate research, draft content, and filter data across departments.",
        "examples": "• Uber (CS summaries)\n• Rivian (Research & learning)\n• Geotab (Data filtering across 4.7M vehicles)"
    },
    {
        "title": "Creative Scale Agents",
        "desc": "The fastest-growing frontier. Gen AI moving from text into multimodal creative production at enterprise scale.",
        "examples": "• Virgin Voyages (Veo hyper-personalized ads)\n• Figma (Brand-approved asset generation)\n• PODS (Real-time adaptive billboards)"
    }
]

for i, pat in enumerate(patterns):
    shape = slide6.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, col_left[i], col_top, col_width, Inches(5.5))
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(250, 250, 250)
    shape.line.color.rgb = RGBColor(200, 200, 200)
    
    tf = shape.text_frame
    tf.clear()
    
    p1 = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p1.text = pat["title"]
    p1.font.bold = True
    p1.font.size = Pt(22)
    p1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0, 102, 204)
    p1.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    
    p2 = tf.add_paragraph()
    p2.text = "\n" + pat["desc"]
    p2.font.size = Pt(16)
    p2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(60, 60, 60)
    
    p3 = tf.add_paragraph()
    p3.text = "\n" + pat["examples"]
    p3.font.size = Pt(16)
    p3.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0, 0, 0)
    p3.font.bold = True


# Slide 7: Strategic Takeaways
slide7 = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[1]) # Bullet layout
slide7.shapes.title.text = "Takeaways: Where to Start and What to Expect from Enterprise Gen AI"
slide7.shapes.title.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(40)
slide7.shapes.title.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.bold = True

tf = slide7.shapes.placeholders[1].text_frame
tf.clear()

takeaways = [
    "Gen AI is production-ready across all major industries: Organizations are rapidly scaling deployments.",
    "Customer and employee agents are the most common entry points: Conversational assistants and workplace productivity tools dominate.",
    "Measurable ROI is achievable within months: Reported outcomes include 500% ROI, 30% workload reduction, and thousands of hours saved.",
    "Creative and code agents are emerging fast: Unlocking multimodal capabilities and developer productivity at scale.",
    "The pace of adoption is accelerating: The 10× growth in 18 months suggests early movers are gaining compounding advantages."
]

for i, text in enumerate(takeaways):
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(24)
    p.space_before = Pt(14)
    p.level = 0

prs.save('/app/output/final_deck.pptx')
print("Successfully generated /app/output/final_deck.pptx")
